AiEvaluationDefinition.description: The demo ladder plus a router-regression case for the Acme Enterprise hiring agent, run as a repeatable AiEvaluationDefinition. Covers: candidate count, roster lookup, screening-with-rubric, and outreach drafting.
AiEvaluationDefinition.name: Acme_Enterprise_Triage_Ladder

expectation.expectedValue: The agent reports the total number of candidates on file. The response must literally contain the number 25.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

expectation.expectedValue: The agent lists candidates on file. The response must name at least three of these three candidates, by first and last name: Elena Vasquez, Maria Gonzalez, Marcus Chen.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: Who has applied to the Senior Full-Stack Engineer role?

expectation.expectedValue: The agent returns a ranked top-5 list with rationale for each candidate, flags at least one candidate with a human-review warning (the response must contain a ⚠ character), and calls out at least one candidate's resume as AI-padded/AI-generated-sounding, naming at least one of: Tyler Brooks, Chloe Nakamura, Viktor Petrov.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: Screen all candidates on file for: Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Northwind logistics platform. Requirements: 5+ years, React/TypeScript, Node services, AWS.

expectation.expectedValue: The agent drafts a short outreach email. The response must name Elena Vasquez or Maria Gonzalez as the recipient/subject of the email.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: Draft a short outreach email to the strongest candidate.

conversationHistory.message: Screen all candidates on file for: Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Northwind logistics platform. Requirements: 5+ years, React/TypeScript, Node services, AWS.

Top-ranked: 1) Elena Vasquez (95/100) - 6 years React/TypeScript, Node, and AWS, strong fit. 2) Maria Gonzalez (88/100) - solid full-stack background with AWS deployment experience. 3) Marcus Chen (74/100, ⚠ human review recommended) - meets most requirements but resume phrasing reads as AI-generated in places.

expectation.expectedValue: The agent drafts a short, professional outreach email to Elena Vasquez, grounded in her actual candidate profile (Staff Software Engineer, React/TypeScript platform rebuild experience, logistics domain background). The response must name Elena Vasquez and must not invent details not present in her profile.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: Draft a short outreach email to Elena Vasquez.
